limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter wrap but also made ready_a high during reset and on the first post-reset sampling edge, and suppressed valid_b during gaps after five accepted bits, changing behavior the reference preserves.

The test could catch the original counter bug, but it required the rewrite’s constant-high ready_a and expected valid_b to stay low during gaps before the sixth bit, so it validated the extra changes instead of detecting them.
